summary: The working-tree change was exported as a standalone unified diff. A fresh disposable copy passed apply-check and apply; the applied formatter file was byte-identical to the working copy. A replay probe produced identical output on both trees and passed 27/27 checks: all private-key shapes after replay, six authentication-code carriers, an authorization-scheme JWT, a double-quoted cloud-key secret, benign six-digit/zip text, public-certificate text, public-key text, and a known-host base64 line, plus every test function in the two repository secret-detector test files (ten log tests and four out-of-band tests). Evidence strength: patch replay plus repository-test replay with benign controls. Limits: tests ran through a minimal package shim because optional connector dependencies are absent; handler wiring was not separately exercised; the official host-side evaluator was not run, so the benchmark verdict remains unverified.
next_hint: Run the official host-side evaluator on the exported patch JSONL. If it is unavailable, retain the local replay and regression evidence as unverified and report the environment blocker separately.
